mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the cold gas with the central disk connected matter lost from the planetary disk to the birth of new stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine the gathered returning gas with the central disk led nowhere, despite the preceding description suggesting it could join central star-forming gas.

surprise.text: The tail-shell gas first had to meet the returning galaxy's extended gas rather than the central disk; the failed attempt automatically revealed and performed that encounter.

arbitrary.text: The gathered returning gas having no available follow-up felt unclear, given that its description said some could join central star-forming gas.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the central stars and their outflow change the shared galaxy, although the unavailable follow-up was frustrating.
